title: Foundations & Readiness
entry: Assigned by the Pre-Algebra Readiness Gateway when prerequisite evidence indicates targeted reinforcement is needed.
exit: 80% mastery plus completed reasoning corrections routes directly to Official Unit 1.
student_message: This is a preparation pathway, not a failure or repeated course. It strengthens the exact skills that will make the official course easier to learn.

lessons.title: Number Sense & Operations
lessons.mastery_evidence: Accurate computation plus explanation of reasonableness.

lessons.title: Fractions, Decimals, Percents & Ratios
lessons.mastery_evidence: Move flexibly among representations and solve a proportional application.

lessons.title: Variables & Mathematical Language
lessons.mastery_evidence: Translate, evaluate, and explain an algebraic expression.

lessons.title: Equations & Inequalities
lessons.mastery_evidence: Solve and verify equations while identifying an invalid step.

lessons.title: Coordinates, Patterns & Functions
lessons.mastery_evidence: Connect a rule, table, coordinate points, and graph meaning.

lessons.title: Measurement, Geometry & Integrated Readiness
lessons.mastery_evidence: Complete an integrated readiness challenge and Unit 0 mastery assessment.
